statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-92387: an FTP, IMAP, POP3 or SMTP server that keeps sending data but never sends the final line of a control response can keep libcurl looping in its response reader, bypassing the configured transfer timeout and blocking every other transfer on the same multi handle (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92387.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 8.10.0 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/753735af87f5c30cb6f60a70342f8bc4bc5fd5db. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The fix adds a loop counter, maxloops, to Curl_pp_readresp(). In the debug information for libcurl.so.4 shipped in curl-dbg, on x86_64 and aarch64, Curl_pp_readresp() has a maxloops local variable in 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1 and none in any earlier build (the same lookup finds its gotbytes variable in every build), so 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build.
